title: Amplify ELA Quests
jpTitle: Amplify Education ELA クエスト

summary.en: Ready-to-use AR and multimedia 'Quest' learning modules — 5-day ELA lesson sequences with scripts, teacher guides and embedded assessments — so any teacher, not just the most skilled, could deliver engaging literacy instruction. Seven-plus quests spanning grades 3–7, plus a teacher-facing companion app, reached millions of students.
summary.jp: 熟練教師にしかできない授業を、誰でも運用できる形に変えた。5 日間の AR 教材「Quest」を 7 つ以上、学年 3〜7 向けに制作した。台本・指導書・評価も組み込み、全米で数百万人の生徒に届いた。

product.en: Designing for the gap between what the best teachers could achieve and what an average teacher could deliver — packaging expertise into ready-to-use 5-day sequences with scripts, guides and embedded assessments so quality didn't depend on who was teaching.
product.jp: 台本・指導書・評価まで揃った 5 日間の教材にした。誰が教えても質が落ちない仕組みにした。

creative.en: Seven distinct narrative worlds — a Poe mystery, a Viking's journey, a Congress roleplay — each shaping its own interface, like a Congress 'drawer' navigation, so the UI reinforced the story rather than sitting outside it.
creative.jp: 議会編は「引き出し」ナビゲーションにした。UI そのものが物語の一部になるよう設計した。

mine: Designed ready-to-use immersive AR/multimedia Quest modules empowering any teacher to deliver engaging ELA instruction
Built each quest as a complete 5-day lesson sequence with scripts, teacher guides and embedded assessments
Integrated AR technology for experiential classroom learning
Designed the teacher-facing companion app for classroom implementation
Designed drawer-based navigation systems inspired by quest content, e.g. the Congress 'Declare Yourself!' drawer UI
Led UX research, persona creation and customer journey mapping across the quest portfolio

narrative.problem: Teachers wanted to deliver engaging, immersive ELA instruction, but creating those experiences demanded specialized skills, time and technical knowledge that most educators didn't have — the gap between what the best teachers could achieve and what the average teacher could deliver was widening.
built: 7 named Quests across grades 3–7 (e.g. 'Who Killed Edgar Allan Poe?', 'Perception Academy', 'Declare Yourself!', 'A Far From Home: A Viking's Journey', 'The Contraption Quest', 'The Robot Quest', 'Myth World')

user: Millions of students reached across the US
